cases.description: Microsoft's documented worked example: the hyperbolic cosecant of 1.5
cases.expected_note: Microsoft's page publishes this example's result to four decimals as 0.4696. Independently derived from csch(x) = 1/sinh(x) = 2/(e^x - e^-x): 1/math.sinh(1.5) = 0.46964244059522464 -> 0.469642441 at 9 dp, agreeing with the published 0.4696

cases.description: The hyperbolic cosecant of -1.5, which must be the negative of that of +1.5
cases.expected_note: sinh is odd, so csch = 1/sinh is odd as well: CSCH(-1.5) must be exactly -CSCH(1.5). Verified independently: 1/math.sinh(-1.5) = -0.46964244059522464

cases.description: An argument at the documented magnitude limit of 2^27
cases.expected_note: Excel documents: "The absolute value of Number must be less than 2^27" and "If Number is outside its constraints, CSCH returns the #NUM! error value." 2^27 = 134217728 is exactly the excluded boundary. Mathematically csch(134217728) underflows to 0, so this case tests the documented range check rather than the arithmetic. EXECUTED RESULT: all four LibreOffice builds return 0 instead of the documented error, i.e. they answer the mathematics and ignore the range check
Excel documents: "If Number is a non-numeric value, CSCH returns the #VALUE! error value."
